units.source_text: 此时比叡山横川地方住着某僧都，是个道行高深的法师。

en.t: At that time, a certain bishop lived in the Yokawa district of Mount Hiei, a priest of profound spiritual attainment.

units.source_text: 他有一个八十多岁的老母和一个五十岁左右的妹妹，都是尼僧。

en.t: He had an aged mother in her eighties and a younger sister of about fifty, both of them nuns.

units.source_text: 这母亲和妹妹很早以前许下愿心，此时要到初濑的观世音菩萨那里去还愿。

en.t: Long before, the mother and sister had made a vow, and now they were going to Hase to fulfill it before the Bodhisattva Kannon.

units.source_text: 僧都叫一个他所亲信而重视的弟子阿阇梨陪去，办理佛经供养等事。

en.t: The bishop sent along an acarya disciple whom he trusted and valued, to accompany them and arrange sutra offerings and other rites.

units.source_text: 在那里做了许多功德，归途上经过一个叫作奈良坂的山的时候，那母亲生起病来。

en.t: After performing many meritorious devotions there, they were on their way home and passing over a mountain called Narazaka when the mother fell ill.

units.source_text: 年高的人生了病，怎么能再走余下的路程而安抵家中呢？

en.t: How could someone so old, once taken ill, travel the remaining road and reach home safely?

units.source_text: 大家都很担心。

en.t: Everyone was deeply worried.

units.source_text: 幸而宇治那边有一家向来相识的人家，就向这人家投宿。

en.t: Fortunately, there was a household in Uji that they had long known, so they sought lodging there.

units.source_text: 那老尼姑休养了一天，病还是很重，只得派人到横川去通知僧都。

en.t: The old nun rested for a day, but her illness remained grave, so they had no choice but to send someone to Yokawa to inform the bishop.

units.source_text: 僧都正闭居在山中修道，曾经立下誓愿：今年决不下山。

en.t: The bishop was secluded in the mountains for religious practice and had vowed that he would not come down from the mountain that year.

units.source_text: 但他闻此消息，深恐老母风烛残年，亡身于旅途，非常担心，连忙下山到宇治来探视。

en.t: But when he heard the news, he feared that his aged mother, near the end of her life, might die on the road, and in great anxiety he hurried down to Uji to see her.

units.source_text: 虽然高寿之人死不足惜，但僧都还是亲自同几个道行高深的弟子举行祈祷，骚扰起来。

en.t: Although the death of one so advanced in years might not be considered cause for deep regret, the bishop himself joined several highly accomplished disciples in prayers, causing a great commotion.

units.source_text: 这人家的主人闻知了，说道：“我们要到吉野御岳去进香，正在这里斋戒。

en.t: When the master of the house learned of this, he said, “We are preparing to make a pilgrimage to Mount Mitake in Yoshino, and are observing purification here.

units.source_text: 这样年老的人在这里生重病，倘有三长两短呢？”

en.t: If someone this old becomes gravely ill here, what are we to do if the worst happens?”

units.source_text: 他深恐家里死了人不吉，有妨斋戒。

en.t: He greatly feared that a death in the house would be inauspicious and would interfere with their purification.

units.source_text: 僧都闻之，觉得此事确也难怪，实甚对他不起。

en.t: When the bishop heard this, he felt that the concern was understandable and that he had truly imposed on the man.

units.source_text: 又嫌此地狭窄而且肮脏，想带老母回家去。

en.t: He also disliked how cramped and dirty the place was, and wanted to take his mother home.

units.source_text: 无奈此时回家方向不利，不宜出行。

en.t: Unfortunately, the direction toward home was inauspicious at that time, so it was not proper to set out.

units.source_text: 忽然想起已故朱雀院的领地中有一所屋子名叫宇治院，就在这附近，那守院人是和僧都相识的，便派一使者前往，要求借宿一两天。

en.t: Then he suddenly remembered that on the estate of the late Suzaku院 there was a house nearby called Uji-in, whose caretaker was acquainted with him, so he sent a messenger to ask for lodging for a day or two.

units.source_text: 使者回来报道：“守院人全家都到初濑去进香了。”

en.t: The messenger returned and reported, “The caretaker and his whole family have gone on pilgrimage to Hase.”

units.source_text: 他带了一个形容很古怪的看家老翁来。

en.t: He brought back an oddly dressed old man who was minding the place.

units.source_text: 这老翁说：“如果你们要来住，请早点来。

en.t: The old man said, “If you wish to come and stay, please come soon.

units.source_text: 院中的正屋都空着呢。

en.t: The main buildings inside the residence are all empty.

units.source_text: 到这边来进香的人常常来投宿的。”

en.t: People who come on pilgrimage in this direction often lodge here.”

units.source_text: 僧都说道：“这便好极了。

en.t: The bishop said, “That is excellent.

units.source_text: 这屋子虽然是皇家的，但无人居住，倒很舒服。”

en.t: Although the house belongs to the imperial family, no one lives there, so it should actually be quite comfortable.”

units.source_text: 便先派人去看看。

en.t: He first sent someone to look it over.

units.source_text: 因为常有人来投宿，这老翁惯于招待，虽然设备简陋，也整饬得很清楚。

en.t: Because people often came to lodge there, the old man was used to receiving guests, and though the furnishings were simple, everything was neatly arranged.
